name: CandelsHighOpen
summary: This EA uses a custom candlestick pattern signal (CSignalCHO - Candles High Open) to generate trade entries and exits within the MetaQuotes standard Expert Advisor framework. It combines the candlestick signal with Parabolic SAR trailing stops and fixed-percentage risk money management to systematically open and manage positions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义的K线高开信号（CSignalCHO）在MetaQuotes标准EA框架内生成交易入场和出场信号。它将K线信号与抛物线SAR追踪止损和固定百分比风险资金管理相结合，系统性地开仓和管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于K线高开形态（CandelsHighOpen），即当蜡烛图的开盘价接近最高价时产生交易信号，这通常表明强烈的买方力量。入场条件由SignalCandelsHighOpen信号模块决定，通过阈值过滤（ThresholdOpen=10, ThresholdClose=10）来控制开平仓信号强度。出场条件结合了固定止损止盈（各50点）和抛物线SAR追踪止损，SAR参数为步长0.02和最大值0.2，可以在趋势延续时锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定风险比例模式（MoneyFixedRisk），默认风险比例为10%，根据止损距离自动计算手数。信号权重设为1.0，可启用反向信号模式进行逆势交易。整体策略属于K线形态识别驱动的趋势跟踪系统，利用标准EA框架实现信号、追踪和资金管理的模块化组合。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Candles High Open pattern (CSignalCHO), which generates trade signals when a candle's open price is near its high, typically indicating strong buyer momentum. Entry conditions are determined by the SignalCandelsHighOpen module, filtered through configurable threshold values (ThresholdOpen=10, ThresholdClose=10) that control the minimum signal strength required to open or close positions. Exit conditions combine fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels (both 50 points) with a Parabolic SAR trailing stop (step=0.02, maximum=0.2), which locks in profits during trend continuation. Position sizing uses a fixed risk percentage model (MoneyFixedRisk) with a default risk of 10%, automatically calculating lot size based on the stop-loss distance. The signal weight is set to 1.0, and a reverse signals mode can be enabled for counter-trend trading. Overall, this is a candlestick pattern-driven trend following system leveraging the standard MQL5 Expert framework for modular integration of signals, trailing, and money management.

parameters.name: Expert_EveryTick
parameters.description_en: Whether to execute on every tick

pros: 采用标准EA框架，模块化设计清晰，信号、追踪止损和资金管理分离
使用Parabolic SAR追踪止损，在趋势行情中能有效锁定利润
固定风险比例资金管理根据止损距离自动计算手数，风险可控
支持反向信号模式，可在趋势和逆势之间灵活切换
信号阈值可调，允许用户根据市场条件灵活过滤交易信号
pros_en: Uses the standard MQL5 Expert framework with clean modular design separating signals, trailing stops, and money management
Parabolic SAR trailing stop effectively locks in profits during trending markets
Fixed risk percentage money management auto-calculates lot size based on stop-loss distance for controlled risk
Supports reverse signal mode for flexible switching between trend-following and counter-trend trading
Configurable signal thresholds allow users to flexibly filter trade signals based on market conditions
cons: 10%的固定风险比例偏高，单笔交易风险过大，容易导致账户快速回撤
止损止盈均设为50点且相等，没有考虑市场波动率，可能在高波动环境中频繁止损
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护，在点差较大的品种上可能造成不必要的损失
EveryTick设为false意味着仅在新K线开盘时检查信号，可能错过重要的价格变动
核心信号模块CSignalCHO的实现未在此文件中，无法评估信号逻辑的具体质量
cons_en: 10% fixed risk percentage is excessively high per trade, potentially causing rapid account drawdown
Equal stop-loss and take-profit at 50 points ignores market volatility, likely causing frequent stop-outs in volatile conditions
Lacks spread filter and slippage protection, which may cause unnecessary losses on high-spread instruments
EveryTick=false means signals are only checked on new bar opens, potentially missing important price movements
The core signal module CSignalCHO implementation is not in this file, making it impossible to evaluate the actual signal logic quality
improvements: 降低默认风险比例至1-3%，并增加最大单笔风险上限以防止过度杠杆
增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使止损距离适应市场波动率
添加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时暂停交易以避免不必要的损失
增加新K线检查机制和多重时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Reduce default risk percentage to 1-3% and add a maximum per-trade risk cap to prevent excessive leverage
Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit so stop distances adapt to market volatility
Add spread filter to pause trading when spread is too wide, avoiding unnecessary losses
Add new bar check mechanism and multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability

risk_points: 默认风险比例10%过高，单笔亏损可能严重影响账户
固定止损50点不考虑市场波动率，低波动时止损过宽浪费利润空间，高波动时止损过窄容易被打
缺少点差过滤，在流动性差或新闻时段可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: Default 10% risk per trade is excessively high; a single loss can severely impact the account
Fixed 50-point stop-loss ignores market volatility - too wide in low volatility wasting profit potential, too narrow in high volatility getting stopped out easily
No spread filter means trades may execute at unfavorable prices during low liquidity or news periods

It combines the candlestick signal with Parabolic SAR trailing stops and fixed-percentage risk money management to systematically open and manage positions.
